 By  The Assam Tribune - 24 Oct 2026 5:04 PM IST X Representational Image
 Guwahati, October 24 : Teer Result is a lottery game. People who buy tickets for the Juwai Teer game can check the lucky number for the first and second rounds, here Winners are decided on the basis of the number of arrows shot in a particular round. 
 Juwai Teer Result is based on an archery game organized by Club Juwai 
 The teer lottery is a legal game governed by rules framed under the Meghalaya Amusement and Betting Tax Act.
